narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I skip the coil. I write two lotuses, fifteen heels and three strokes.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>Count the heels in his row. Ten heels are worth the same as one coil.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A heel never appears ten times, so that long row must be swapped.
